name: Beitou Hot Spring Museum
scope: The restored 1913 Beitou public bathhouse, including the timber upper entrance and galleries, lower red-brick bath wing, intersecting tiled roofs and chimneys.
era: The bathhouse as reopened as a museum in 1998 and photographed in the 2009 Qualla originals.

originalReview.notes: The exact Qualla published version traces to the photographer’s 2009 own-work public-domain original. Timestamp removal and a minor rotation were compared against the archived bytes. The image shows the projecting genkan and upper windows, covered gallery and south slopes of the tiled roof.
